result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the first card in the "Popular right now" section has a failed/missing image, leaving an empty gray placeholder block with a broken-image icon. The favorite (heart) button on that card also renders with a washed-out gray background instead of the dark treatment used on other cards.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in "Popular right now" shows a blank gray area with a broken-image glyph instead of the restaurant photo, while sibling cards (e.g. the pizza card below) load correctly.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL/asset for this listing and add a branded fallback image or a subtle skeleton/placeholder state so a failed load doesn't leave an empty gray block with a broken-image icon.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the broken-image card uses a light gray translucent circle with a gray outline icon, giving low contrast and an inconsistent look compared to the dark circle with white icon on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent overlay button style (solid dark scrim with white icon) regardless of whether the underlying image loaded, ensuring adequate contrast.

issues.description: The empty image container for the ramen card is noticeably shorter than the neighbouring pizza card's image, causing uneven card heights in the vertical list.
issues.suggestion: Enforce a fixed aspect ratio on card image containers so placeholders occupy the same height as loaded images.
